## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Cagliari, Italy. It starts at Zona Industriale Macchiareddu.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Hop aboard a mini train and get carted around a beautiful landscape filled with salt mountains, multicolored water pools, and hundreds of pink flamingos. Alice in Wonderland has got nothing on the Conti Vecchi Saltworks! Discover the story of this otherworldly Sardinian heritage site with a guided tour.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €11.88. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 78 ratings and 53 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
